# Project Phoenix v47.0 — Alt-History Situation 2: Ulugh Beg's Samarkand Renaissance & Gunpowder Crossroads (1444-1565).
# Native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live 0..100 meters `oe_v47_samarkand_science` & `oe_v47_timurid_cohesion`).
# Human-friendly & AI-restrained (`is_ai = no` or `has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed`).
# Generated by gen_v470_alt_mamluk_timurid.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v47_samarkand_renaissance = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v47_samarkand_renaissance

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1444
		current_year <= 1565
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_ended }
		OR = {
			country_exists = c:TIM
			location:samarkand = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
			any_country = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				OR = {
					tag = TIM
					tag = TRS
					tag = TRN
					tag = PER
					tag = IRA
					tag = ABL
					tag = QAR
					tag = AQQ
					tag = DLH
					tag = MUG
					tag = CHG
					tag = GUR
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
							region = region:persia_region
							region = region:khorasan_region
							region = region:hindustan_region
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			tag = TIM
			tag = TRS
			tag = TRN
			tag = PER
			tag = IRA
			tag = ABL
			tag = QAR
			tag = AQQ
			tag = DLH
			tag = MUG
			tag = CHG
			tag = GUR
			tag = TUR
			tag = MAM
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
					region = region:persia_region
					region = region:khorasan_region
					region = region:hindustan_region
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Samarkand Scientific-Gunpowder Golden Age (science >= 85 & cohesion >= 70)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_samarkand_out_golden_age"
		desc = "oe_v47_samarkand_out_golden_age_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_science }
				var:oe_v47_samarkand_science >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion }
				var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion >= 70
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_ended value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_golden_age_achieved value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = TIM
						tag = TRS
						tag = TRN
						owns = location:samarkand
						has_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_patron
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 20
				add_research_progress = 15
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_samarkand_golden_age years = 35 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Eclipse of the Observatory & Scholarly Diaspora (cohesion <= 20 after 1480)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_samarkand_out_reaction"
		desc = "oe_v47_samarkand_out_reaction_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1480
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion }
				var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion <= 20
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = TIM
						tag = PER
						tag = IRA
						tag = TUR
						tag = MUG
						owns = location:samarkand
						has_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_patron
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_samarkand_diaspora_scholars years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Enduring Crossroads of the Silk Road (1565 era close)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v47_samarkand_out_crossroads"
		desc = "oe_v47_samarkand_out_crossroads_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1565
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						tag = TIM
						tag = TRS
						tag = PER
						tag = IRA
						tag = DLH
						tag = MUG
						owns = location:samarkand
						has_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_patron
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v47_mod_silk_gunpowder_crossroads years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 35 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 45 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_eu2_13_seen }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						is_ai = no
						OR = {
							tag = TIM
							tag = TRS
							tag = TRN
							tag = PER
							tag = IRA
							tag = ABL
							tag = QAR
							tag = AQQ
							tag = DLH
							tag = MUG
							tag = CHG
							capital ?= {
								OR = {
									sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
									region = region:persia_region
									region = region:khorasan_region
									region = region:hindustan_region
								}
							}
						}
					}
					AND = {
						tag = TIM
						has_global_variable = oe_v49_alt_ai_unleashed
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_13_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_patron value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v47_eu2_ev_cd value = 1 days = 360 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v47_eu2.13
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_science } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 35 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion } } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 45 } }

		# Live Samarkand Scientific Breakthrough tracking
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:samarkand = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= {
						is_rebel_country = no
						OR = {
							has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_zij_sultani_tables
							has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_samarkand_artillery_academy
							has_country_modifier = oe_v47_mod_registan_polymaths
							has_reform = government_reform:oe_v47_ref_samarkand_observatory_court
						}
					}
				}
				var:oe_v47_samarkand_science < 88
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science add = 0.40 }
		}

		# Live Timurid / Transoxiana Cohesion tracking
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:samarkand = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= {
						is_rebel_country = no
						owns = location:bukhara
						owns = location:herat
						stability >= 10
					}
				}
				var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion < 84
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion add = 0.35 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:samarkand = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= {
						OR = {
							stability < 0
							at_war = yes
						}
					}
				}
				var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion > 15
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion add = -0.25 }
		}

		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_samarkand_science > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_samarkand_science < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_science value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v47_timurid_cohesion < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v47_timurid_cohesion value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v47_samarkand_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v47_samarkand_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = TIM tag = TRS tag = TRN } }
					area = area:transoxiana_area
					region = region:khorasan_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_sam_map_timurid_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = PER tag = IRA tag = ABL tag = QAR tag = AQQ } }
					region = region:persia_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_sam_map_persia_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = DLH tag = MUG } }
					region = region:hindustan_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_sam_map_india_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = CHG tag = GUR } }
					sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v47_sam_map_silkroad_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = TIM tag = TRS tag = TRN } }
					area = area:transoxiana_area
					region = region:khorasan_region
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = PER tag = IRA tag = ABL tag = QAR tag = AQQ } }
					region = region:persia_region
				}
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = DLH tag = MUG } }
					region = region:hindustan_region
				}
			}
			value = saffron
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				OR = {
					owner ?= { OR = { tag = CHG tag = GUR } }
					sub_continent = sub_continent:central_asia
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v47_sam_legend_timurid"
		color = rgb { 36 154 166 }
	}
